dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Primary systemic (AL) amyloidosis with periorbital purpura (raccoon eyes), secondary to underlying plasma cell dyscrasia

Alternatives:
1. Occult basilar skull fracture with delayed periorbital ecchymosis (not excluded despite negative CT/MRI, and patient may have forgotten or denied minor trauma)
2. Valsalva-induced periorbital hemorrhage (from coughing, vomiting, or heavy straining causing sudden venous pressure rise into fragile periorbital vessels)
3. Acquired von Willebrand disease or monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance with associated bleeding tendency
order_raw:
1. Non-contrast CT head
2. Full blood count with differential blood film
3. Coagulation screen (PT, aPTT, INR, fibrinogen)
4. CT of facial bones and orbits
5. Serum protein electrophoresis and serum free light chain assay
6. Urine for Bence Jones protein
7. Liver function tests including albumin
8. Serum amyloid A and NT-proBNP (amyloidosis screen)
9. Morning serum cortisol
10. Bleeding time and von Willebrand factor antigen and activity
11. Bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy
12. Abdominal fat pad biopsy for Congo red staining
13. MRI brain with contrast (if CT inconclusive)
